decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation builds directly on the firm's in-house laser expertise, so its own R&D can interpret early feedback and refine it, although its thinner web presence suggests a niche role.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core coding portfolio and has its own dedicated page, so existing knowledge and the service network allow effective assimilation and improvement.

The piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's established inkjet know-how for high-resolution coding on varied surfaces, fits its strategy of matching technology to application, and is prominently presented.
